about: Labelled pairs for which question admits a pair to rung 2.5. Each row is a same-subject, same-lineage pair rung 2.5 could date, 'older' stated first. Many carry a date in the claim text, the form claude-sonnet-5-5's extractor writes ('as of <date>', 'as stated in a session dated <date>'), which is the form the contradiction probe clears because two dated claims can both be true at their own times. 'expected' is what rung 2.5 should do with the pair: 'changes' (the newer claim gives the slot a new value, so the older one is retired), 'not_changes' (both stay current: a second value that coexists, a separate event, added detail, a past value, a decision not yet carried out, a bounded stay after a lasting value, a claim that relied on the old value, or a fixed fact), or 'report' (printed, never barred). Class 'case' holds the trip case's own pairs as the extractors wrote them in the end-to-end runs of 2026-10-12; they are reported apart from the general classes. Bars, from the acceptance plan (item 2): on each model, under the proposed gate, every barred 'changes' row settled CHANGES (both readings) in at least two of three samples, and no settled CHANGES in any 'not_changes' sample. The shipped gate (contradiction probe YES and settled CHANGES) is computed from the same samples and reported beside it.
